# README hero preview (not published)

When approved, replace the README header image with:

```html
<img src=".github/assets/fajita-readme-hero.png" alt="Fajita open-source uptime monitoring for websites, APIs, SSL, and cron jobs. Verifies failures before alerting." width="720" />
```

## Preview files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `.github/assets/fajita-readme-hero.svg` | Editable source |
| `.github/assets/fajita-readme-hero.png` | GitHub README image (1280×640) |

## What the graphic shows

- Fajita brand lockup and headline
- Monitor types: HTTP, API, SSL, CRON
- Thermal Stack illustration in verifying state (core differentiator)
- Bottom flow strip: check → detect → verify → alert → status page

Open the PNG locally to review before publishing.
